subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback be enabled automatically for HTML stubs with no extracted media, default-off behind channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback, or folded into one combined channel/group repair?
rationale: The central bug is source-reproducible, but the fallback default changes existing deployments through Graph call volume, permissions expectations, diagnostics, and whether attached files reach the agent-visible message context.

options.title: Combine or choose one complete repair
options.body: Use the broader channel URL/thread fix together with a maintainer-approved fallback policy so one PR resolves the canonical issue without overstating coverage.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Keep current behavior for existing installs and let operators enable extra Graph message reads when they need group/channel attachment recovery.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Recover attachments without new config but accept extra Graph reads and possible mention-only noise for Teams group/channel HTML stubs.

recommendation.title: Combine or choose one complete repair
recommendation.body: Use the broader channel URL/thread fix together with a maintainer-approved fallback policy so one PR resolves the canonical issue without overstating coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: History points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate for the msteams plugin boundary and config/fallback product choice.
